universe_consistency.purpose: Verify signal is not specific to one universe
universe_consistency.procedure: Compare incremental IC in ENV-050 vs ENV-100
universe_consistency.metric: Difference in incremental IC between universes

horizon_consistency.purpose: Verify signal is not specific to one horizon
horizon_consistency.procedure: Compare incremental IC at H-10 vs H-20
horizon_consistency.metric: Difference in incremental IC between horizons
horizon_consistency.interpretation: Both must be positive for confirmation
horizon_consistency.classification_rule: CONSISTENT if both positive; INCONSISTENT otherwise

model_consistency.procedure: Compare Ridge vs Lasso incremental IC at H-10
model_consistency.metric: Difference in incremental IC between models
model_consistency.interpretation: Both must be positive for confirmation
model_consistency.classification_rule: CONSISTENT if both positive; INCONSISTENT otherwise

temporal_segmentation.purpose: Verify signal stability across time periods
temporal_segmentation.procedure: Split OOS period into halves; compare incremental IC
temporal_segmentation.interpretation: Both halves should show positive IC
temporal_segmentation.classification_rule: STABLE if both positive; UNSTABLE otherwise

feature_perturbation.procedure: Test VOL_ZSCORE with different rolling windows (200, 252, 300)
feature_perturbation.interpretation: IC should be positive across windows
feature_perturbation.classification_rule: ROBUST if all positive; SENSITIVE otherwise

missing_data_sensitivity.purpose: Verify sensitivity to missing data handling
missing_data_sensitivity.procedure: Compare results with drop vs forward-fill for missing values

prohibition: No robustness scenarios may be added after OOS results are observed
